subject: Next steps: vendor security path & scope clarifications for HealthBridge
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Greene <alyssa.greene@healthbridge.com>, security_ops@healthbridge.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: vendor security path & scope clarifications for HealthBridge

Hi Alyssa — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call so we stay aligned: 

1) Scope and priority
- You confirmed HealthBridge will evaluate Redwood for a patient-data-facing feature; HIPAA scope likely required.
- Security priorities: encryption at rest + in transit, SOC 2 evidence, pen test results, and SSO/SAML integration.

2) Questionnaire approach
- We typically complete either a SIG Lite/Full spreadsheet or a CAIQ prefill depending on buyer preference. To save time we can prefill answers and supply evidence first.

3) Immediate asks for you (to help us accelerate)
- Which questionnaire format do you prefer (SIG spreadsheet vs CAIQ vs your custom template)?
- Do you need the SOC 2 Type II report up-front or will an in-progress SOC 2 (we’re Type II in progress; expected completion Q4) plus an attestation letter suffice for initial security review?
- Any specific evidence items that must be included in the intake (e.g., pen test report within last 12 months, encryption certs, data processing addendum)?

4) Proposed next steps
- If SIG preferred: we can send a prefilled SIG/CAIQ by Friday and attach primary evidence.
- If custom form: please attach the template and we’ll map answers.
- Schedule a short follow-up with Monica (security eng) if you want a technical deep-dive.

Attachments: we’ll prepare a prefill and evidence bundle.

If you can confirm preferred questionnaire and any hard blockers (must-have evidence), we’ll prioritize that path.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0133
--
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_prefill-CAIQ-20260520.xlsx (spreadsheet, stub)
From: Alyssa Greene <alyssa.greene@healthbridge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: security_ops@healthbridge.com
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 09:17:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: vendor security path & scope clarifications for HealthBridge

Ben — appreciate the summary and the clear asks. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Questionnaire format: We prefer SIG Full for vendor risk, but will accept a CAIQ prefill if you can map answers back to the SIG columns. SIG Full preferred because our tooling ingests it directly.
- SOC 2: we do require SOC 2 Type II. If Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II in-progress, we will accept an interim attestation + evidence for an initial review, but the final Type II report will be requested prior to production access.
- HIPAA: yes, the integration will be in-scope for HIPAA. We will need a signed BAA and evidence of technical safeguards (encryption at rest, TLS 1.2+ for in transit), plus a description of access controls and audit logging.
- Evidence: most critical for us up-front: pen-test summary (last 12 months), SOC control mapping, and a sample audit log retention policy.

I’ve attached our previous vendor assessment (PDF) to show the format our security team typically expects.

Timeline: we aim to complete vendor onboarding reviews within ~2 weeks if we get a prefilled SIG + primary evidence. Can you commit to that window?

Thanks —
Alyssa Greene
Director, Information Security | HealthBridge
alyssa.greene@healthbridge.com
Attachment: HealthBridge_prev_vendor_assessment.pdf (PDF, stub)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Greene <alyssa.greene@healthbridge.com>, security_ops@healthbridge.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: vendor security path & scope clarifications for HealthBridge

Alyssa — great, thanks for the clear guidance and the example assessment. We can align to SIG Full and provide a CAIQ prefill that maps to your SIG columns to speed ingestion. A few clarifying points so we deliver exactly what you need: 

1) Evidence package content (please confirm if any of the below are mandatory):
- SOC 2 Type II final report (not yet complete) vs interim attestation — you said interim is OK for initial review. Confirmed?
- Pen test: summary + scope. We can include our latest third-party pen test summary (Q1 2026) and provide the full report under NDA if required.
- Audit logs: we will attach our audit logging policy and a sample retention extract.

2) HIPAA / BAA timing
- We can provide a standard BAA. Do you require the BAA signed before the SIG is submitted, or can that be executed after initial security review?

3) SSO / SAML metadata
- If you need SSO details for testing, we can either provide test IdP metadata or coordinate a short SSO runbook call. Which do you prefer?

4) Delivery timeline
- We can deliver a prefilled SIG + evidence package within 5 business days (target: next Friday) if you confirm SIG Full + the interim attestation approach.

Proposed immediate action: If you confirm the above two items (interim attestation acceptable; BAA timing), I’ll upload the prefill to the shared Drive link and loop Monica for any technical Qs.

Best —
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0133
Attachment: redwood_prefill-CAIQ-20260520.xlsx (spreadsheet, stub)
From: Alyssa Greene <alyssa.greene@healthbridge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 09:21:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: vendor security path & scope clarifications for HealthBridge

Thanks Ben — that timeline works. Confirmations: 

- Interim attestation is acceptable for the initial review; final SOC 2 Type II required prior to production.
- BAA: we prefer a signed BAA before any production data exchange, but for the security intake you can submit the SIG and evidence beforehand. We’ll request the signed BAA before go-live.
- SSO: please send SAML metadata; we will test in a staging tenant.

I’ll ask security_ops to ingest the SIG once you upload. Target: 2 weeks to close initial review if we receive the prefilled SIG + pen test summary + audit log extract.

Attaching a small doc with our ingestion notes and required evidence checklist.

Best —
Alyssa Greene
Director, Information Security | HealthBridge
alyssa.greene@healthbridge.com
Attachment: HealthBridge_onboarding_prio_checklist.pdf (PDF, stub)
